scope: P1-A57 classic Liu Biao, Zishou/Zongshi rules and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名当前经典刘表（群3体力，自守／宗室）

sources.use: 当前官方武将页：群势力3体力；自守按现存势力数额外摸牌并限制本回合出牌阶段的其他角色目标；锁定技宗室按现存势力数增加手牌上限；同时提供574x761经典形象大图。
版本页区分经典与界限突破；经典规则问答确认自守后可使用无中生有，五谷丰登仅以自己为目标并只亮一张牌，跳过摸牌阶段时不能发动自守。
按用户指定概念页区分锁定标签、触发入口和持续状态；自守为State + Trigger，宗室为Locked + State。

ruleText.zishou: 摸牌阶段摸牌时，你可以额外摸X张牌（X为现存势力数）。若如此做，你于本回合出牌阶段内使用的牌不能指定其他角色为目标。
ruleText.zongshi: 锁定技，你的手牌上限+X（X为现存势力数）。

implementation.livingFactionProjection: distinct effective faction ids of living players

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: the private use/skip choice, frozen living-faction count and active turn usage reconstruct from the accepted command prefix
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: rules v105 keeps both runtime effects disabled even when package 1.84.0 is loaded; package 1.83.0 does not register Liu Biao

portrait.attribution: Official classic Liu Biao artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

assertions: Zishou publishes one private use/skip choice with an exact living-faction count and replays while paused
using Zishou draws normal cards plus the frozen living-faction count and records one Turn usage
other-target cards and group attacks disappear while self-use cards remain
Five Grains confirms only Liu Biao as target and therefore reveals one card
Zongshi hand limit drops immediately when the only living member of one faction dies
rules v105 and package 1.83.0 preserve both pre-Liu-Biao boundaries
official portrait, both skill texts, draw choice and live turn state are visible without clipping

excludedVariants: boundary Liu Biao with damage prevention and end-phase replacement text
older classic text using total faction count instead of the selected official living-faction wording
deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
